label: Shipping Checkpoints
purpose: Show a shipment timeline (e.g. Ordered -> Order Ready -> Delivered) with estimated dates for each stage
_notes:
Completely redesigned since the old catalog entry: this is now a TIMELINE of up to 4 checkpoints, not a 3-item icon+text trust badge row (the old icon_1/text_1/icon_2/text_2/icon_3/text_3/icon_size fields no longer exist). top_text_N/bottom_text_N are inline_richtext (no

wrapping) and support [start_date]/[end_date] placeholders that render as real dates when enable_date_formatting is on, computed from min_days_N/max_days_N (days from today). icon_N is a Material Symbols icon name; icon_N_image overrides it with an image. The 4th checkpoint is optional — leave both top_text_4 and bottom_text_4 empty to hide it entirely; do not fill it in unless a genuine 4th stage is needed. days_labels/months_labels override the day/month abbreviations used in date formatting (comma-separated: 7 day names, 12 month names). days_to_skip/dates_to_skip exclude specific weekdays or calendar dates (e.g. weekends, holidays) from the date math. Excluded as pure visual: filled_icon_N, top/bottom text font sizes, color_scheme, margins. visibility (desktop/mobile hidden) excluded as device-display control, not content.
